prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph looking straight down from the ceiling of one small bed-and-breakfast room in an English town at night. A double bed and a travel cot fill nearly the whole floor; between them a narrow strip of worn carpet with bin bags of clothes, a pushchair folded against the wall, a kettle and cereal boxes on the floor because there is no kitchen. Two adults and a small child asleep under the duvet, turned away, only hair and shapes. The only light is a buzzing fluorescent tube by the door, cold teal, with the rest in shadow. 28mm lens, slight wide-angle bend at the edges. Night colour film, heavy grain, muddy blacks. Thanks.
